name: AI-Ready Design Systems
description: Curated, scored catalog of production-grade design systems for AI agents to choose from and build with.

rubric.label: Official MCP server (agent can query components/docs live)
llms-full.txt (whole docs as one markdown file)
Machine-readable design tokens in the repo
Typed component API (TypeScript / Swift / Kotlin / Dart / C#)
Registry / CLI install of component source (e.g. shadcn registry)
Agent docs: skills shipped in the package, or AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / cursor rules in the repo
Accessibility guidance shipped with the source

localUse: In a clone of the repository, every URL under the site URL maps to the site/ folder; "path" fields are relative to site/.

productShapes.app-dashboard: Data-heavy app screens: tables, filters, charts, forms
productShapes.saas-app: General product UI for a web app
productShapes.content-site: Docs, blogs, catalogs, directories, long-form reading

usageNote: "usage" holds public numbers exactly as returned by the GitHub API, npm, pub.dev and NuGet on 2026-11-09. Nothing is estimated; null means the source has no number (for example no public repo). There are no star ratings or reviews: issue counts and contributors are the community-feedback signals. "bestFor", "brandLocked" and "productShapes" are editorial (curated) fields, not measurements.
